subject: general
question: In a volleyball game, each team comprise of how many players?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Volleyball:-**

 
 
• **It is a team sport in which two teams of six players are separated by a net. **
 
• Each team tries to score by grounding a ball on the other team's court under organized rules.
 
• **It has been a part of the official Olympic program since 1964.**
 
• **The game is played on a rectangular court divided into two equal-sized squares by a net.**
 
• The net is 2.43 meters (8 feet) high for men and 2.24 meters (7 feet 4 inches) high for women.
 
• The ball is a spherical ball with a circumference of 65–67 centimeters (25.6–26.4 inches) and a weight of 260–280 grams (9.2–9.9 ounces).
 
• The game starts with a serve, in which one player from the serving team hits the ball over the net.
 
• The opposing team must then use three hits to return the ball over the net.
 
• **If the ball touches the ground within the opposing team's court, the serving team scores a point. **
 
• **If the ball goes out of bounds or is not returned over the net correctly, the opposing team scores a point. **
